question: Should Skill Workshop approval-gated apply, reject, and quarantine calls be bound to the proposal version current when the approval prompt is created?
rationale: The PR changes existing lifecycle execution from acting on the latest pending proposal to rejecting stale prompts, which is a user-visible fail-closed policy choice that code correctness and green CI cannot settle.

options.title: Bind approval prompts
options.body: Keep the fail-closed version snapshot so an approval acts only on the proposal version represented by its prompt.

options.title: Bind explicit reviews only
options.body: Keep legacy approval prompts proposal-ID-only and attach proposal_version only after an explicit review action.

options.title: Preview without binding
options.body: Land exact previews but retain latest-version lifecycle execution, accepting review-to-apply drift.

recommendation.title: Bind approval prompts
recommendation.body: Keep the fail-closed version snapshot so an approval acts only on the proposal version represented by its prompt.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent lifecycle-approval repair and the explicit request in the PR discussion make this the best available owner for confirming the contract.
